FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A01
Impaired driving draws top enforcement priority, while OWI itself means .08 BAC or any controlled substance [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint owi-basis; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec11-F01 and sec11-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A01
Acquittal still costs 180 days of privileges, while repeats stretch revocations further [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint owi-penalty; prereq_hint sec11-F02; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec11-F03.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A01
Licenses pre-consent to sobriety tests for residents and visitors, while refusal out-punishes failing with a year off plus $1,250 [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint consent-refusal; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec11-F04 and sec11-F05.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A01
Underage OWI starts at .02 with 60-day revocations, while adult-level .08 stretches them to 180 days [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint youth; prereq_hint sec11-F02; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec11-F07 and sec11-F08.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A01
Cabin open containers fine every occupant $200, while trunk transport stays lawful [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint container; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec11-F09.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A01
Drowsiness kills like drunkenness, while its mind warnings span daydreams, yawns, and drooping heads [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint drowsy; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec11-F10 and sec11-F11.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A01
Road warnings span drifting, tailgating, and rumble strips, while 18 waking hours match 0.08 impairment [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint drowsy; prereq_hint sec11-F11; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec11-F12 and sec11-F13.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A02
Weather, work zones, and crashes shape every trip plan, while Iowa 511 reports them online and in-app [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint trip-plan; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec11-F14 and sec11-F15.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0038]
